title: Plasmon modes in tilted three-dimensional nodal-ring semimetals. II. Vortex nodal ring
summary: We investigate collective charge excitations in three-dimensional semimetals with dipole-like Berry-curvature (BC) profiles, focusing on vortex nodal-ring semimetals (VNRs) and Hopf semimetals (HSMs). The VNR hosts a continuous ring of dipole-like BC sources generated by its winding pseudospin texture, whereas the HSM hosts an ideal BC dipole. This allows us to examine how distinct realisations of dipole-like BC structure affect collective charge dynamics.
